debug_mode.description: Debug level (bitwise flags) for ipv6calc. 0 disables debug output.

db_ip2location_dir.description: Directory path for IP2Location database files. If empty, IP2Location support is disabled.

db_geoip_dir.description: Directory path for GeoIP database files. If empty, GeoIP support is disabled.

tasks.description: List of processing tasks to execute sequentially. Each task defines input, types, and actions for ipv6calc invocation.
